title: Terminal section transport commutes with a diagonal cone map
statement: Let H be a sheaf of sets on R [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], U,W etale objects over R [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], q:U to W a site map, T any scheme, p:T to R, t:T to U.left and t0:T to W.left. Assume t followed by q.left is t0, t followed by U.hom is p, and t0 followed by W.hom is p. The inverse-image unit along p on H(U), followed by restriction along the diagonal lift (t,identity) [def-pc-fibre-product], followed by terminal transport [def-weil-pbc-sets-terminal-transport] for W.hom,t0,p, equals terminal restriction for U [def-weil-pbc-sets-terminal-restriction], followed by terminal transport for W.hom,q.left,U.hom, followed by the canonical section comparison [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison] for t,q.left,t0 evaluated on W.hom inverse image H and the terminal object over W. No etaleness is assumed on p,t,t0.

source.place: Tag 03S2, paragraph following Definition 03S3; Tags 03CB and 03CC. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03S2, /03CB and /03CC; local source files are absent. The explicit terminal-section formulas and compatibility calculations are written by U1 from these adjunction and restriction facts.

proof.text: Express a section s of H(U) as a terminal section of U.hom inverse image H using terminal restriction. The restriction unit equation says that this terminal section is the unit applied to s at U, followed by the diagonal lift (identity,identity) into U base changed along U.hom. The map under restriction has first projection identity, so it returns s. This uses the stated restriction-unit equation and invertibility of its terminal component.

Expand the terminal transports and section comparison. Unit naturality with the diagonal lift moves this representative through t inverse image. The composition-unit equation for U.hom and t identifies the twice pulled-back representative with the p-pulled-back section. Associativity for W.hom, q.left and t identifies the composition comparisons in the other route with the one for W.hom and t0, after the three given triangle equalities. Naturality of these sheaf isomorphisms moves all object restriction maps to the end.

The remaining object maps are canonical pullback-pasting maps and the second projections of pullbacks of identity objects. On both sides the map from T to U base changed along p has first projection t and second projection identity. The pullback universal property makes it exactly the diagonal lift. Cancel the composition and terminal-object isomorphisms; equality transports coincide by proof irrelevance. This gives the displayed equation on every s, hence the morphism equality. Identity triangles and empty schemes are included since no nonemptiness or etaleness of p,t,t0 was used.
